children: JD Insurance Advisory (Hong Kong) has formally set up an offline service center in Hong Kong, located on the 16th floor of One Peking, a building known for housing many insurers, according to Ming Pao.
The move comes after Ming Pao reported last October that JD.com (9618) had entered Hong Kong's insurance brokerage business, although no major developments had been seen until now.

title: JD.com Insurance Advisory Opens Offline Service Center in Hong Kong
